reason: The company secured a significant Rs. 854.57 crore contract with SAIL-IISCO, boosting its order book to over Rs. 10,000 crores and providing clear revenue visibility.
why_now: The contract was officially announced via exchange filing on 2026-10-09.
source_headlines: SEPC Limited: We hereby informed the Exchange of the press release titled "SEPC Limited MD Signs Rs. 854.57 Crore Contract with SAIL-IISCO Steel Plant at Contract Signing Ceremony in Burnpur; Consolidated Order Book Crosses Rs. 10,000 Crores". Detailed letter is enclosed.
